zh: 填满前 k 行恰好需要 1+2+…+k=k(k+1)/2 枚硬币，所以答案就是满足 k(k+1)/2≤n 的最大非负整数 k。
三角数随 k 单调递增，可以对 k 二分；为避免浮点误差，判断时直接用整数乘法计算 k(k+1)/2。
对每个 n：先令 hi=1 并不断翻倍直到 hi(hi+1)/2>n，lo=0；在 lo+1<hi 时取 mid，若 mid(mid+1)/2≤n 则 lo=mid，否则 hi=mid；lo 即答案；所有结果按顺序空格分隔输出。
en: Filling the first k rows takes exactly 1 + 2 + ... + k = k(k+1)/2 coins, so the answer is the largest non-negative integer k with k(k+1)/2 <= n.
Triangular numbers grow with k, so binary search k; to avoid floating-point rounding, compute k(k+1)/2 with integer multiplication in the test.

For each n: start with hi = 1 and double it until hi(hi+1)/2 > n, with lo = 0; while lo + 1 < hi take mid, set lo = mid if mid(mid+1)/2 <= n, otherwise hi = mid; lo is the answer. Print all results in order, space-separated.

explanationEn:
## Approach

For each n, find the largest k with 1 + 2 + ... + k = k(k+1)/2 <= n. Binary search k, using integer multiplication in the test to avoid floating-point rounding.

## Proof of correctness

Filling k rows uses exactly k(k+1)/2 coins, so the number of rows that can be filled is exactly the largest non-negative integer satisfying this inequality. Binary searching the monotone triangular numbers determines each result uniquely.

## Complexity

With N the array length: time O(N log C), space O(N), where C = max(coins).
